The structure of the rooms is there, but the next big step is filling them out with decorations, puzzles, and of course, plenty of enemies.

I also hit another milestone this week—I finished the last new illustration needed for this update! This one features the silver lycanthrope getting her paws on a helpless Mila…
 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/1f0e3bd896ddc67d9b633b1ff3823afb8c359989.jpg"]

discord.gg/Mqz6WGn95j

notes.title: WEEKLY UPDATE!! 8/3/25
notes.notes:
This past week, I completed my full run of the Vampire Route to help clear up a few lingering details as I continue writing Chapter 4. During that playthrough, something stood out to me that’s been nagging for a while—specifically, the pacing at which Mila and her Pets receive weapon upgrades. It felt a bit too sparse in places, so I’ve gone back and added a few more weapon chests to earlier areas. I also expanded the game’s database with several new weapons that will be introduced later in the story.

Alongside that, a new item will be debuting in the upcoming update: the Sapientia Laurel!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/942399841e7c3ef1b3a4dfd3d2fc8e002618c2fb.jpg"]



Until now, there hasn’t been a way to raise the Magic Attack stat with a Laurel, but that’s about to change. These new Laurels will be quite rare in the Hunter Route—replacing certain treasure locations—but they’ll be more common in the Vampire Route and even purchasable in select shops!

I also took some time to revisit and update one of my personal favorite illustrations in the game—Vampire Mila, curled up and cozy in her coffin. I’d never gone back to fix the missing belt holders on her pants until now, but more importantly, I’ve created a new alternate version featuring Mila in her dark vampire route gown… except this time, she’s about to be staked?!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/c90270ee05e13a8c6987490d1bd7a2ea68ea94a4.jpg"]

All preview images are currently available to Tier 2+ patrons on the Crimson Veil Discord and will be going live on Patreon later this week!



discord.gg/Mqz6WGn95j



https://www.patreon.com/c/MKRUdesign



Lastly, a quick heads-up: there will be no update next Sunday, as I’ll be heading out on a short trip with friends! We’ll be visiting Epic Universe in Orlando, and I’m super excited to check it out. That said, I’ve already scheduled some new art to go live next Sunday, so patrons and Discord members will still have something to look forward to at the usual time.

That’s all for this week—see you all once I’m back!

Big thanks to everyone who participated in Contract Contest #11, both the voters and anyone who submitted their ideas! The contest has come to a close and the winner has been chosen. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/c6796d0fd5629bcb82b01d7849d8ce35c287ab9e.jpg

Working on facial expressions is one of the most engaging parts of the creative process for me. So much of a character’s personality is brought to life during this stage. Sometimes, it feels like I can almost hear the character’s voice in my head, and their mannerisms and actions just come naturally. I get the sense that I understand Kyless much better now, as well as Effie, the character that I am currently working on. Vampire mythology is often associated with Christianity, but aside from the use of crosses, I’d rather have my game’s lore follow its own rules and not mess with any real world religion or its figures. Hey everyone! This week I began working on something that I had been thinking about making for a long time. As a solo creator, it's hard for me to keep track of all the facts within my fictional world, especially as Crimson Veil continues to grow in its scope. To help catalog these details, I have started writing a Lore Bible for the game. So far, I have added short bios for each of the characters, including facts that are not said explicitly within the game’s text, but help flesh them out. There’s also details such as each character’s full name, age, height, weight, and the nationality they are based on.

Crimson Veil takes place in the fictional world of Gaia Solvus. The areas players visit are inspired by European countries. I have not created an official map yet, as I feel it could limit me creatively, but I have still given each of the characters a nationality that can later be adapted to my world’s equivalent. 

This is a list that I am continuing to update as I go, but if you are interested in learning a bit more about the game’s world, you can read through it here:

Crimson Veil Lore Bible

Be cautioned however, that there are some facts that could be considered spoilers, so I recommend that you at least finish the main story before skimming through it. Also, I’m only human, so if I miss a fact or misstate something here, please let me know so I can address it. I’m trying to keep things consistent moving forward, and this side project will most certainly help with that! Also, if there are any details you think that I should add, let me know.

Next up, I have a preview of the Edge Weaver’s fate upon being defeated.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/846bf6b95c94a39750b88f7365d5ddf30013571a.gif

Their bodies are altered over their various sessions and adapt to make them the perfect meal for a thirsty vamp. Their senses become heightened. Their heart beats quickly if they sense a vampire nearby, luring them and priming their own blood to be consumed. Even their blood’s flavour changes in subtle ways to be more appetising.

I settled on the names for the next two chapters and created title graphics for them, created new sprites for some characters, cleaned up some bugs I discovered while playing through the android port, sketched out 2 more characters, finalized the character portrait of another, and (nearly) finished mapping one of the bigger and more interesting areas of the next update!

Fallholt has gone through some extensive social changes over the last century. As Mila and the player will discover, Fallholt has become a thriving city which has integrated vampires into their society! Indeed, Fallholt has become a city where vampires and humans live alongside each other, ruled by the vampiric Queen Anja.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/cad92e43e67f4a7d488808dd20f3bbb3f15a327e.jpg
 
Though initially a controversial decision, the current generation of mortals within Fallholt have grown to see their vampiric neighbors as equals rather than as monsters. All turnings must be sanctioned by the Queen herself and the creation of ghouls is highly illegal. To enforce these policies, the Queen established the Knights of Friedrich and recruited vampire hunters to slay those that choose to live against her laws.

Indeed, Fallholt is a city where vampires can live and even shop freely! The newly established Fallholt Center of Commerce is open 24 hours a day, employing vampires at night and humans during the daylight hours. With a constant flow of income throughout the day, the economy of Fallholt is more prosperous than at any other point in it’s history!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/0441eddf12932e3ba3d87817beda301d4930f4fc.jpg
 
The center acts as an upscale shopping mall, with multiple stores and activities to spend your hard earned gold. I’ve made the area feel bustling by adding in multiple NPCs that go in and out as you shop. This touch really makes the center come alive, even if the shop owners you’ll interact with are well, “dead”.
I hope this short teaser of the next chapter has intrigued you and left you with many questions. I can’t guarantee they’ll all be answered, but my goal is to make revisiting this familiar city an interesting trip!

Until next time, everyone!

This week was mainly spent working on completing those new illustrations. I have 4 more illustrations to get through out of 11, so I’m making some good progress. Work on the game’s end was spent on some smaller things, namely text on interactable events within the Rosenblad Estate.

Now that the Countess in Crimson quest is nearly complete, I’m starting to shift focus to the second quest, Terror of the Seas. The majority of the maps are done, as I have stated before. It’s a matter of finalizing some of the rooms, laying out the puzzles, and finally scripting the events. Truth be told, I’ve gone back and forth on how exactly I want the scenario to play out. As I was drafting the scenario, I realized that having Mila control a crew of pirates with a ship would be handy for a future scenario. But how would a crew of vampire pirates sail during the day? To resolve this conundrum, I decided to use this opportunity to instead explore a facet of vampirism that was only briefly touched upon. The concept of a blood thrall.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/c457f040da1d45dc57463bcd3e009a291f208f0d.jpg
 
One of the earliest Bad Endings has Mila turned into a thrall, which can remotely perform tasks for a vampire, seemingly even during the day. Here are the ground rules I’ve established for them:

A thrall is born when a hypnotized victim is continuously bitten and healed of vampirism by a master vampire (through holy water or some other means). Thralls are addicted to getting bitten by the vampire that caused those bites. Though they are not undead themselves, the bodily fluids of a thrall can corrupt other humans and make them thralls of their master vampire. Thralls also grow an appetite for blood, though they do not need it to survive. Thralls can be better controlled than a hypnotized victim, and perform tasks more naturally than hypnotized victims can in a tranced state. Thralls can blend into society and do a vampire’s bidding during the day and remotely. A thrall can also be manipulated into not realizing they are a thrall, creating a sort of “sleeper agent” out of the victim. A thrall’s control can only be broken if the master vampire is destroyed and even then, the thrall will go into withdrawal, longing for their master long after they are dead. Widowed thrall’s often seek ways to revive their master or somehow become vampires themselves to continue their bidding in some way. This behavior can be treated with extensive therapy, however the victim’s bodily fluids will remain infected, unbeknownst to them. In rare cases this can cause multiple humans to turn into a thrall if the master vampire is resurrected.

Having a thrall around seems rather useful, so why have there been no examples of other thralls up until now? In most cases, having a victim turn into a vampire is more satisfying as a bad ending. But, I feel that the vampire route is the perfect place to reintroduce this concept!

Lastly, I have this week’s art teaser. This is for the Countess in Crimson’s Bad Ending:

Hello again everyone! I've got an exciting update for you this week!

A highly requested feature will be implemented in the vampire route! I'm happy to announce the Pets system is getting expanded! Specific pets will now be able to join Mila in battle! Let me give you a rundown on how I will implement this change in game...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/9dddbb4a1730587b09c1312130a55eeb40602fc3.jpg
 
As of this update, three different Pets will be able to join Mila: Vicilla, Lauren, and Edith. You may only have one ally with you at a time and you can visit their locations to swap with them when you want. Each of these allies serve a different role in battle. Vicilla is a berserker with high power, though at the cost of being uncontrollable. Lauren is nimble and can cast healing spells and buffs. Edith can distract enemies and tank hits better than other allies. Each ally's level scales to whatever Mila's level is, so even if you don't use them, they won't be left behind in power.

However, by raising their affinity, you can unlock stat increases and additional skills for them! A prompt will appear once you have reached a certain affinity threshold and that is your cue to go speak with them at their designated location to raise their level!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/a6df8d16b5ecca7be7c633496023aa68025c97ac.jpg
 
Affinity can be raised in multiple ways: Defeating enemies together, completing quests with them, and giving them food. Due to this specific change, all food items may only be used outside of battle. However, the best way to increase their affinity is by taking them out on a dinner date!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/0c3d74af4612eabe7d4899b5d0196f3a4f671960.jpg
 
By taking an ally with you to the new Humilem Bistro, you will be able to order food and drinks for your date. Each girl has specific tastes, which you may infer from their support conversations. If you purchase a meal that suits them, you'll receive a larger affinity bonus at the end of the date!

Be aware, although your allies are vampires, they aren't "immortal". They can still get defeated in battle!
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/ec68ecc37a860504cd994d9ed90f480263ad12a5.jpg

When you obtain your first ally, you will also unlock the "Resurrect" Skill, which will revive an ally at a hefty cost to HP and SP. Allies regen HP and SP slower than Mila and generally have lower stats. Their combat options are also much more limited. Most concerning, if Mila falls in battle, her ally will immediately join in her demise!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/fd3cd0baeeb4901e71b6e11f2de670fda1c4f31c.jpg
 
Mila's servants must ensure their Mistress survives no matter the cost!

This particular update to the Pets system has taken a bit of time for me to get working properly and there is still a good amount of tweaking I'll have to do to the difficulty to get it right and not feel overpowered. I still have a lot of additional writing to do for each of these support conversations, but I feel that the effort will be worth it, because the main appeal of the vampire route is going around and turning girls into vampires. It would feel pretty shallow if you were unable to explore some of the girls you turn, so I hope that the players will create a bond with their favorite girl and get to know them!

Before anyone asks, this dating sim aspect of the Pets system will only be for these three characters for now. I wanted to create three different class archetypes for the allies and with how I have currently designed this system and with all the writing I still have to do... It was just too much to include in one update. Bianca and Ophelia will get their time to shine as an ally eventually. I have specific plans for Bianca actually, that I wish I could share, but you'll all just have to stick around to find out!

*Whew* That was quite a lot to go through! I hope you all are excited for this change and are looking forward to interacting with these new allies. One last thing to share before I end it for this week. I finished the wolfy version of the Vicilla art from two weeks ago. Here's a small teaser:
